ACT-POLYC-SELFHOST-LEXER04-CORRECTION04 -- C1 -- N02 mutation contract
======================================================================

# Per ACT §22: choose exactly one mutation class. Frozen at C1.
# Per ACT §23: do not edit the tracked production subject in place;
# copy to build/tmp/lexer04-correction04/.

N02_MUTATION_KIND=B
N02_MUTATION_CLASS=B_reduce_out_target_len_by_one_preserving_ok
N02_MUTATION_TARGET=LinkScanAngle
N02_MUTATION_SITE=after LinkCopyBytes call inside LinkScanAngle
N02_MUTATION_EDIT=*out_target_len = *out_target_len - 1;  // drop the last body byte

# Expected semantic effect:
#   For fixture L07:
#     Pristine: link_libs=lib-complex_1.0
#     Mutated:  link_libs=lib-complex_1.
#   For other fixtures, behavior unchanged unless they coincidentally
#   pass through LinkScanAngle.

N02_EXPECTED_FIXTURE=L07
N02_EXPECTED_FIELD=link_libs
N02_EXPECTED_PRISTINE_VALUE=lib-complex_1.0
N02_EXPECTED_MUTATED_VALUE=lib-complex_1.

# Per ACT §24 expected machine-readable witnesses:
N02_REQUIRED_TOKEN=PRISTINE_COMPONENT_SHA256
N02_REQUIRED_TOKEN=MUTATED_COMPONENT_SHA256
N02_REQUIRED_TOKEN=COMPONENT_SHA_DIFFERS
N02_REQUIRED_TOKEN=MUTATED_COMPONENT_BUILD_RC
N02_REQUIRED_TOKEN=MUTATED_SEAM_SHA256
N02_REQUIRED_TOKEN=MUTATED_SEAM_LINK_RC
N02_REQUIRED_TOKEN=MUTATED_SEAM_RUN_RC
N02_REQUIRED_TOKEN=MUTATED_PRODUCTION_DIVERGENCE_DETECTED
N02_REQUIRED_TOKEN=UNEXPECTED_MUTATION_DIVERGENCE_COUNT
N02_REQUIRED_TOKEN=PRISTINE_REVERIFY_RC

# Per ACT §23 staging directory:
N02_STAGING_DIR=build/tmp/lexer04-correction04/
N02_PRISTINE_COPY=${N02_STAGING_DIR}selfhost-lexer-link.PRISTINE.HC
N02_MUTATED_COPY=${N02_STAGING_DIR}selfhost-lexer-link.MUTATED.HC

# Per ACT §23: NEVER mutate the tracked subject.
TRACKED_SUBJECT_MUTATED_DURING_N02=NO

# Per ACT §25 required negative selftest:
N02_NEG_SELFTEST_KIND=remove_mutated_object_sha
N02_NEG_SELFTEST_OUTCOME=N02_INCOMPLETE_WITNESS_REJECTED=YES
